r.name: European walking route E9, Isle of Wight alternative
Fine fortifications trail at Bembridge and Culver Downs, Isle of Wight
r.description: Bembridge & Culver Downs once had much military activity. Follow this easy circular along the top of the downs to gain insight into the Isle of Wight's role in wartime defence & intelligence, & to look out to Sandown Bay, Whitecliff Bay & Brading Haven

r.name: Bembridge and Culver Downs trail, Isle of Wight
r.description: East island circular with views of the coast, countryside & from Culver Downs. Via the only surviving windmill on the island, along coast path & past a Victorian fort & RSPB Brading Marshes. Uneven surfaces, 1 steep ascent mid trail, steps & stiles.

r.name: Circumnavigate Culver Down Trail, Isle of Wight
r.description: A short exhilarating clifftop walk over Culver Down, taking in the historic Bembridge Fort & Yarborough Monument, along with views over Sandown Bay & Brading Haven. Watch out for peregrines, ravens, cowslips & butterflies. Tricky sections in bad weather.

r.name: Borthwood Copse Red Squirrel Walk, Isle of Wight
r.description: Short walk in a secluded part of the island, through woods home to the red squirrel. Trees are beautiful in autumn. In spring the woodland floor is carpeted with bluebells. No gates or stiles. Uneven, muddy & paths not wide enough for easy wheelchair use

r.name: A Coastal Walk at St Helens Duver, Isle of Wight
r.description: Varied coast walk exploring St Helens Duver. Along a sandy spit rich in wildlife & history. From Bembridge harbour pass along the rocky seashore before climbing inland & returning via picturesque St Helens. Beware of tides. Steep, slippery gradients.

r.name: The Duver Walk, Isle of Wight
Down on the Duver Circular Walk, Isle of Wight
r.description: A short, varied & circular exploring St Helens Duver spit. Pass Bembridge Harbour, the Golf Club & village of St Helens & its famous Old Church. Varied birdlife includes waders, whitethroats, wheatears & chiffchaffs. Steps, uneven paths & mild gradients.

r.name: Ventor Downs Prehistory and Wartime Walk, Isle of Wight
Views of Ventor Walking Trail, Isle of Wight
